comparison.objective: Install a rack rail; record unmolds a tart from a loose-bottom pan onto a stand.
comparison.physical_skill: Rigid mechanical latching and fastening versus level bimanual support and lowering a ring without contacting or damaging fragile food.
comparison.success_condition: Rail self-supports after complete engagement and correct screws for 3 s versus tart/base centered and level, ring lowered flat, no tart contact/shift, and a 1 s released hold.
comparison.reason: Both involve maintaining level support, but their defining interactions and damage criteria are unrelated.
